Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
